report:
Reviewed the complete alternative_isolation claim, all seven implementation entries (six ordinary sites and one TODO), and all thirteen associated tests (twelve substantive and one TODO), using the refreshed start inputs after association-only edits. Requirements are: isolated inference per disjunct; canonical response publication; order-independent aggregation; preservation of common hard information; output-sensitive merging or explicit dominance; and reconciliation before concurrent conjunct cancellation. The captured architectural-foundations passages explain the isolated producer/context boundary.

Implementation: prove.rs solve_trait_frame and solve_normalize_frame instantiate a new QueryProofState for each candidate, branch locally, extract a stashed response before discarding the local child, and communicate only responses through the whiteboard. The normalization paths include impls, environment trait facts, and normalization facts; a trait-only environment fact contributes uncertainty rather than inventing an associated type. boundary.rs instantiate_query constructs a fresh stash/egraph and recreates canonical inputs. extract_query_result_with_output_at copies substitution, output and residual into a separate stash, binds response-local variables with universe/domain metadata, checks operation/output compatibility and rejects escaped inference variables. Its local ResponseExtractor and IrCopier helpers were inspected, including input-class representative handling and capture-avoiding response copying. These sites are now explicitly associated so changes invalidate this review.

merge_candidate_results sorts and deduplicates responses, filters dead No alternatives, and deterministically removes subsumed definite answers. Only an unconstrained, unconditional Proven answer is absorbing; a value-producing answer cannot use that shortcut. subsumes compares output kinds and types before substitution/residual implication, renames response variables apart and limits directional bindings to consequent witnesses with compatible domains/universes. No general value priority policy is assumed here: agreeing answers or this explicit conservative implication rule are the supported reductions. anti_unify.rs merge_hints copies surviving response substitutions apart, intersects keys across all possible alternatives, inserts an unconstrained possibility for incomplete sources, recursively preserves shared constructors/components, preserves common explicit binder domains, excludes inaccessible inputs, drops unconstrained bare witnesses and publishes only used canonical witnesses. Skeleton decomposition/recomposition was captured and inspected. These account for the completed-answer common-knowledge implementation.

Test assertions: final_answer_rules_are_order_independent compares the complete canonical answer for three mixed No/Maybe/Proven permutations and checks all-Maybe/all-No reductions. duplicate_identical_yes_is_one_answer checks duplicate conditional responses reduce to Yes. unconditional_type_output_does_not_hide_an_incomplete_source checks value output plus incomplete source remains Maybe. divergent_bare_values_produce_empty_hard_hint checks incompatible Bool/I32 substitutions yield no hints or binders. anti_unification_retains_shared_constructor_and_component asserts tuple shape, retained Bool component, fresh differing component and exactly one binder. merged_bare_hints_preserve_a_common_response_domain checks an Integer-domain witness survives mixed Yes/Maybe with matching binder metadata; merged_nested_hints_preserve_a_common_response_domain checks Integer survives inside a common tuple. distinct_response_domains_do_not_subsume_each_other preserves ambiguity for Integer versus Float. general_conditional_answer_subsumes_specific_one asserts the general result survives without the narrower substitution. directional_subsumption_binds_only_repeated_consequent_witnesses checks full equality with the repeated-witness general answer for matching tuples and ambiguity for inconsistent repeated positions. subsumption_witness_cannot_capture_a_newer_rigid_input checks the universe restriction. The harness test supplies duplicate bool associated values versus bool/i32 conflicting values, asserts Yes versus Maybe without an expected-output filter, and checks balanced unordered normalization-candidate inspection spans. Its fixture/root-module and symbol-selection helpers were captured and inspected; substantive assertions remain visible in the test.

Explicit deferral: semantic_spec::todo::solver_alternative_isolation is not executable verification. Its implementation explanation defers concurrent conjunction and cancellation isolation beyond current completed-answer reduction. The test matrix further defers complete candidate-order permutations and failed/cancelled candidate equality, universe, wake and obligation leakage observations, plus sibling reconciliation before an absorbing conjunction result. The prerequisite is a concurrent-conjunction scheduler/reconciliation implementation and cancellation instrumentation exposing those effects. Current prove_conjunction processes goals serially in one child transaction; it does not implement the specified concurrent sibling cancellation protocol. Accepting this pre-existing TODO does not claim those guarantees implemented or tested. The existing matrix remains visibly deferred; no ordinary evidence was demoted and no claim weakened. There are no N/A entries.

Execution distinct from inspection: cargo fmt completed; cargo test -p sage-ir check::solve::merge::tests --lib passed 13 tests; cargo test -p sage-test-harness incompatible_normalization_outputs_are_ambiguous_but_identical_outputs_merge --lib passed 1 test; cargo build succeeded with existing warnings. The TODO placeholder was inspected, not counted as a behavioral test. Coordinator owns the centralized delegated post-codegen and Sage sanity checks for these association-only edits. No behavioral defect was reproduced in this review. No further edits are requested for the implemented scope plus explicit deferrals.
